headline: Aerobic efficiency is measurably improving — easy-run HR has dropped significantly at comparable efforts while volume continues to build.
confidence_reasons: Multiple data sources active in last 3 days
summary:
The most meaningful signal in your current data is the drop in easy-run heart rate at similar paces and effort levels. This isn't noise — it represents a genuine shift in aerobic efficiency, likely reflecting the cumulative effect of sustained volume over a 20-week unbroken streak combined with the recent block increase. You're doing more work and it's costing less cardiovascularly.

Volume is progressing sensibly. The current four-week block is up meaningfully on the prior one, and the back-to-back structure of your recent runs — including a solid long effort yesterday — is directly relevant to ultra durability. The 4:24/km lactate threshold logged earlier this week adds a useful reference point as that dataset starts to build; contextualised against your half-marathon PB pace, it suggests threshold fitness is sitting in a strong position.

Strength slightly tapered this block at five sessions versus six prior, which is worth noting but not concerning in isolation — especially given running volume and streak length. The 3-week strength streak suggests you're re-establishing consistency there, which is worth protecting as volume climbs.
watch_items: Monitor whether easy-run HR continues its downward trend or stabilises — a plateau would still confirm adaptation, while further drift could indicate accumulated fatigue
After back-to-back long runs this weekend, observe how quickly your legs feel recovered over the next 48–72 hours — this is useful durability data for ultra preparation
The lactate threshold reference is new and accumulating — track whether threshold sessions feel sustainably repeatable or if RPE creeps up disproportionately at that pace
Strength consistency is worth guarding as the running block grows — watch whether session quality holds even on higher-volume running weeks

evidence_items.text: ▲ 4-week volume 145 km vs 125 km prior block (+16%)
